properties.decision: OPEN (proposed): the storage mechanism for planned epochs is undecided, and deciding it by drift would repeat the mistake BL-100 names. Three candidates are on the table, none chosen.
properties.name: Where does a planned epoch live — a git branch, the graph, or both?
properties.rationale: (a) EPOCH BRANCHES, Anthony's first framing: a git branch per planned epoch holding the expected export — full-document snapshots, diffable with the delta machinery, zero schema change; cost: the roadmap lives outside the graph, invisible to detectors, and n branches of a mutable file invite the lineage problems BL-107 closed. (b) IN-GRAPH FUTURE EPOCHS: Epoch nodes with future sequences, planned nodes pinned AT_EPOCH, the unused ANTICIPATES edge (confidence property) finally reached; roadmap visible to detect_gaps and propagate; cost: no single handable document, and axis-Z was built pointing backward. (c) HYBRID: roadmap in-graph, planned epochs exported to refs on demand; cost: two representations that can drift. AMENDED 2026-07-28, same day, after Anthony's second pass: git already does versions/tags/releases well (industry ships small increments fast — his brother's project, ~2 minors/week), which strengthens git as the SNAPSHOT STORE — but his bottom line reframes the choice: the graph must be the INDEX (see req:graph-indexes-snapshots), so the real shape is likely (c-refined): git stores snapshots under refs it is already good at, the graph owns the map from epoch_n/increment_n to ref plus the planned content, and a user never remembers a branch name. The rel:v0180 <-> tag v0.18.0 pattern is this exact division of labor, already shipping, pointed backward. Still OPEN: whether (b)'s in-graph planned content is required for detectors to reason about the roadmap, or whether the index alone suffices. THIRD AMENDMENT, same day: Anthony's satisfaction-schedule distillation shrinks what a planned epoch has to BE. If the roadmap's atom is 'requirement X expected/required satisfied at epoch_n' — a dated pin with a modality and a confidence — then the plan's content is a set of edges the graph holds natively (AT_EPOCH / ANTICIPATES with confidence), NOT a full expected-graph snapshot per epoch; the full snapshot becomes a DERIVED view (render the graph as of the pins that hold at epoch_n), which further strengthens (c-refined): the graph owns pins and index, git stores any rendered snapshot a human wants to hold in their hands, and nothing stores the same truth twice.
